normalized.result:
This behaves the way I’d expect. The typed tag searches, exact phrases, exclusions, and grouped searches make it possible to narrow things down without adding lots of separate controls. I’d expect AND, OR, and NOT to act as operators normally, but to be treated as ordinary words when I put them in quotes.

The “search isn’t complete yet” note is better than guessing or silently showing no results. The tag suggestions also solve the reuse problem well, including the option to create a genuinely new tag.
